tripd.row.fc: {date}: {verdict}. Rain about {mm} in total, highest chance {chance}. Heaviest hour: {cls}.
tripd.row.fc_daily: {date}: {verdict}. Rain about {mm} in total, highest chance {chance} (daily forecast only, no hourly detail).
tripd.row.tend: {date}: too far ahead for a forecast. In past years (NASA POWER) it rained on about {pwet} of days around this date, on average {mm} a day.
tripd.row.tend_fallback: {date}: the forecast is not available, so this is the usual pattern (NASA POWER, not a forecast): rain on about {pwet} of days, on average {mm} a day.
tripd.rain.windows: Dry spells of 2 hours or more: {list}.
tripd.note.past_clamped: That date has passed, so I started from today.
tripd.note.forecast_failed: The live forecast could not be loaded, so days inside the forecast range show the usual pattern instead.
tripd.note.daily_only: For some days only the daily forecast total is available, without hourly detail.
tripd.unc.forecast: Forecasts can change, more so beyond 3 days. Rain can still fall on a day that looks dry, and short heavy showers are hard to predict.
tripd.unc.tendency: This is what usually happened in past years, not a forecast for that day. The real weather can be quite different.
tripd.unc.dates: Dates inside the forecast range use the forecast; later dates use past years only and are not forecasts. The score is a planning aid.
tripd.link.review: Review the proposed changes on the Trips screen
tripd.cmp.head_similar: The places look similar for {range}; there is no clear difference in rain.
tripd.cmp.mixed_note: Later days in the range are past-year averages, not forecasts, so the totals mix both kinds.
tripd.row.cmp_mixed: {n}. {dest}: forecast {f} over {nf} days plus the usual rain {u} for {nt} later days; highest chance {chance}.
tripd.row.cmp_fc: {n}. {dest}: about {mm} of rain forecast, highest daily chance {chance}.
tripd.row.cmp_tend: {n}. {dest}: usually about {mm} in these days (past years, not a forecast); rain on up to {chance} of days.
tripd.best.head: Best dates for {dest}: {days} days, searched {range}
tripd.row.best_fc: {n}. {from} to {to}: planning score {score}/100, rain about {mm}, average chance {chance} (forecast).
tripd.row.best_tend: {n}. {from} to {to}: planning score {score}/100, usual rain about {mm}, usual chance {chance} (past years, not a forecast).
tripd.row.best_mixed: {n}. {from} to {to}: planning score {score}/100, rain about {mm}, chance {chance} (forecast days plus past-year averages).
tripd.where.head: Places with the least rain, {range}
tripd.where.interest_none: Not enough places match {list}, so I looked at all places.
tripd.where.note: Ranked by total rain among {n} places with data. Rain is only one thing to consider: also check roads, crowds and local conditions.
tripd.where.missing: {n} places had no data and were left out.
tripd.plan.head: A {days}-day low-rain trip: my top suggestions
tripd.plan.save: I cannot book or save anything. Open the Trips screen to save a plan you like.
tripd.mod.head: Rain check for your trip: {trip}
tripd.mod.no_trips: You have no saved trips. Create one on the Trips screen and I can check it against the forecast.
tripd.mod.none: I found nothing that needs to change, based on the forecast.
tripd.mod.approval: These are only proposals: nothing was changed. Open the Trips screen to look at each change and accept or reject it. Confirmed bookings are never changed.
tripd.act.head: Things to do in {dest} on {date}
tripd.act.none: No activities are listed for this place.
tripd.act.hours_note: Opening hours are not available to me, so I do not say whether a place is open.
tripd.row.day_summary: Rain that day: about {mm}, highest chance {chance}, heaviest hour: {cls}.
tripd.photo.head: Photography in {dest} on {date}
tripd.photo.sr_dry: Around sunrise ({time}) little or no rain is forecast ({mm} in that hour).
tripd.photo.sr_wet: Around sunrise ({time}) rain is forecast ({mm} in that hour).
tripd.photo.ss_dry: Around sunset ({time}) little or no rain is forecast ({mm} in that hour).
tripd.photo.ss_wet: Around sunset ({time}) rain is forecast ({mm} in that hour).
tripd.photo.windows: Dry spells of 2 hours or more: {list}.
tripd.photo.no_window: No dry spell of 2 hours or more is forecast.
tripd.photo.light_note: I have no cloud or light data, so I cannot say how good the light will be.
tripd.pack.head: Packing ideas for {dest}, {range} (built from the rainiest forecast day, {worst})
tripd.pack.note: This is a starting list. You can edit and tick items in the packing assistant.
tripd.ex.intensity: Rain per hour: light rain from {light} mm, moderate from {moderate} mm, heavy from {heavy} mm, very heavy above {vheavy} mm. A whole day is shown as a total in mm, not as one of these words.
tripd.ex.sources: Rain forecasts come from Open-Meteo for the next {days} days (not NASA data). Past-year tendencies come from NASA POWER, 1981 to 2025. Seasonal outlooks, where shown, are from Open-Meteo (not NASA).
tripd.ex.imerg: GPM IMERG satellite rain is not used yet.
tripd.ex.tendency: A forecast is only possible for the next {days} days. Beyond that I only show a historical tendency: how often it rained (at least {wet} mm) around that calendar date in past years. It says what is usual, not what will happen.
tripd.ex.score: The planning score (0 to 100) mixes weather {w}%, activity fit {a}%, your preferences {p}% and environment {e}%. The weights can be changed in Settings.
tripd.ex.ml_unknown: I cannot read the model information right now, so no machine-learning estimate is shown.
tripd.ex.ml_yes: A machine-learning estimate is shown only where it beat the simple historical baseline on data it had not seen.
tripd.ex.ml_no: No machine-learning estimate is used: it did not beat the simple historical baseline on held-out data, so the app shows the forecast and the historical tendency only.
tripd.ex.why: I answer from three kinds of data and always say which one. A forecast (next {days} days) is a prediction that can change. A historical tendency is what usually happened in past years. I never make up numbers: if I cannot get the data I say so.
tripd.ex.sources_short: Forecast: Open-Meteo (not NASA). Historical tendency: NASA POWER.
tripd.help.head: What I can help with
tripd.help.limits: I answer only about weather and trips in Sri Lanka, using the forecast and past-year data in this app. I cannot book anything, and I only propose changes to your trips: you approve them on the Trips screen.
tripd.unknown.head: I did not understand that
tripd.unknown.body: I can only answer questions about rain, travel dates, places and packing for trips in Sri Lanka.
tripd.unknown.did_you_mean: Did you mean one of these?
tripd.unknown.try: You could try one of these:

tripd.fail.head: I could not get that data
tripd.fail.forecast: The live forecast could not be loaded and no usable saved copy exists.
tripd.fail.beyond: That day is beyond the {n}-day forecast range, and this question needs the hourly forecast.
tripd.fail.no_data: There is no data for this place and these dates.
tripd.fail.no_windows: I could not find any trip window with enough data.
tripd.fail.tool: A part of the trip planner that I need is not available right now.
tripd.fail.no_guess: I will not guess a number. Please try again later.
tripd.src.forecast_stale: Forecast: Open-Meteo (not NASA data), a saved copy from {time}. It is not current.
tripd.src.tendency: Historical tendency: NASA POWER, {period}. Not a forecast.
tripd.title: AI travel copilot
tripd.intro: Ask about rain, dates, places, activities and packing for Sri Lanka. I look up real forecast and past-year data and tell you where it comes from.
tripd.engine_rules: Answers are built by simple rules from real data, in your browser. This is not a free-writing AI.
tripd.engine_remote: AI wording is available on the server. It only rewords the facts found by the rules; numbers are checked against the facts.
tripd.remote_toggle: Use AI wording (sends my question and the facts to the server's language model)
tripd.remote_note: The wording above was written by an AI language model from the facts below. Check the numbers in the details.
tripd.remote_failed: AI wording was not used this time; showing the built-in answer.
tripd.input_placeholder: For example: Will it rain in Kandy tomorrow?
tripd.thinking: Looking up the forecast and past-year data...
tripd.error: Something went wrong while answering. Please try again.
tripd.restored: Saved from an earlier visit. The numbers may be out of date: ask again for current data.
